```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(meta)
library(metafor)
library(metadat)
library(haven)
library(writexl)
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
options(scipen = 999)
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
appliancespurchase <- read_xlsx("appliances_purchase.xlsx", sheet = "Appliances")
columns <- c("z_value", "z_variance","year_data_study","coefficient", "coefficient_se","p_value", "control_mean","control_sample_size","control_sd","treated_mean","treatment_sample_size","treated_sd","total_observations", "diff_mean","pooled_sd","monetary_incentive_size","monetary_incentive_relative","label_monetary_size","label_consumption_size","d_value")
appliancespurchase[columns] <- lapply(appliancespurchase[columns], as.numeric)
appliancespurchase$z_value <- ifelse(appliancespurchase$effect_direction == "decrease",
                                   -appliancespurchase$z_value,
                                   appliancespurchase$z_value)
appliancespurchase$t_stat <- ifelse(appliancespurchase$effect_direction == "decrease",
                                   -appliancespurchase$t_stat,
                                   appliancespurchase$t_stat)
appliancespurchase$r_value <- ifelse(appliancespurchase$effect_direction == "decrease",
                                   -appliancespurchase$r_value,
                                   appliancespurchase$r_value)
```

```{r}
appliancespurchase$statistical_technique <- ifelse(
  grepl("logit", appliancespurchase$statistical_technique, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "logit",
  appliancespurchase$statistical_technique
)
appliancespurchase$statistical_technique <- ifelse(
  grepl("probit", appliancespurchase$statistical_technique, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "probit",
  appliancespurchase$statistical_technique
)
appliancespurchase$statistical_technique <- ifelse(
  grepl("binomial", appliancespurchase$statistical_technique, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "linear probability model",
  appliancespurchase$statistical_technique
)
appliancespurchase$statistical_technique <- ifelse(
  grepl("ITT", appliancespurchase$statistical_technique, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "logit",
  appliancespurchase$statistical_technique
)
appliancespurchase$experimental_setting <- ifelse(
  appliancespurchase$experimental_setting %in% c("retailer", "sales agent"),
  "retailer",
  appliancespurchase$experimental_setting
)
appliancespurchase$experimental_setting <- ifelse(
  grepl("pre-record", appliancespurchase$experimental_setting, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "retailer",
  appliancespurchase$experimental_setting
)
appliancespurchase$country <- ifelse(
  grepl(",", appliancespurchase$country, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "multiple",
  appliancespurchase$country
)
appliancespurchase$participant_type <- ifelse(
  appliancespurchase$participant_type %in% c("homeowners", "residents"),
  appliancespurchase$participant_type,
  "unspecified"
)
```

```{r}
summary(appliancespurchase)
```

```{r}
appliancespurchase$intervention <- with(appliancespurchase, case_when(
  feedback == 1 ~ "Feedback",
  information == 1 ~ "Information",
  label == 1 ~ "Label",
  rebate == 1 ~ "Rebate",
  tax_credit == 1 ~ "Tax",
  subsidy == 1 ~ "Subsidy",
  loan == 1 ~ "Loan",
  choice_architecture == 1 ~ "Choice Architecture",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
))

appliancespurchase$appliance <- with(appliancespurchase, case_when(
  tv == 1 ~ "TV",
  ac == 1 ~ "Air-Conditioner",
  refrigerator == 1 ~ "Refrigerator",
  dishwasher == 1 ~ "Dishwasher",
  washing_machine == 1 ~ "Washing Machine",
  clothes_dryer == 1 ~ "Clothes Dryer",
  heat_pump == 1 ~ "Heat Pump",
  lighting == 1 ~ "Lighting",
  water_heater == 1 ~ "Water Heater",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
))

data_purchase <- appliancespurchase

data_purchase_washing <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(washing_machine == 1)

data_purchase_dryer <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(clothes_dryer == 1)

data_purchase_dishwasher <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(dishwasher == 1)

data_purchase_refrigerator <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(refrigerator == 1)

data_purchase_heat_pump <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(heat_pump == 1)

data_purchase_lighting <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(lighting == 1)

data_purchase_water <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(water_heater == 1)

data_purchase_ac <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(ac == 1)

data_purchase_tv <- data_purchase %>% 
                  filter(tv == 1)
```

```{r}
### RANDOM EFFECTS MODEL ###
##washing machine
m.gen_purchase_washing <- metagen(TE = z_value,
                 seTE = z_variance,
                 data = data_purchase_washing,
                 studlab = authors,
                 sm = "ZCOR",
                 fixed = FALSE,
                 random = TRUE,
                 backtransf = F,
                 )

## forest plot of purchase

png(file = "forestplot_washing_random.png", width = 6000, height = 3000, res = 500)
forest.meta(m.gen_purchase_washing,
           leftcols = c("authors", "Intervention"),
           digits =6,
           col.random = "Red",
           xlab = "Effect Sizes",
           col.square = "Blue")

### FIXED EFFECTS MODEL ###
  
m1.gen_purchase_washing <- metagen(TE = z_value,
                 seTE = z_variance,
                 data = data_purchase_washing,
                 studlab = authors,
                 sm = "ZCOR",
                 fixed = TRUE,
                 random = FALSE,
                 backtransf = F,
                 )

## forest plot of purchase

png(file = "forestplot_washing_fixed.png", width = 6000, height = 3000, res = 500)
forest.meta(m1.gen_purchase_washing,
           leftcols = c("authors", "Intervention"),
           digits =6,
           col.random = "Red",
           xlab = "Effect Sizes",
           col.square = "Blue")       
```
